legacy_arm.capped_600s: fix, implement, validate each hit the 600 s cap (the Mission tool never returned); question took 52 s with no Mission (classifier skips it)

uncapped_3h.fix: 2h55m, ended BLOCKED. A correct fix (2/2 tests) existed in the preserved candidate but was never accepted: gate said 'no candidate recorded'. Blocked by flint/flint-40b 'Connection error' and a recovery stall, not by the work.
uncapped_3h.implement: hit the 3 h limit, BLOCKED, no code produced; repair tasks failed with 'no routing candidate'.

legacy_arm.with_starting_model_pin: fix, 30 min cap, sandboxed config: the Mission adopted the session model (MODEL_TRANSITION logged) and used only that model (270/270 model references); it did not finish in 30 min, still on its first implementer task with a live worker. Cause (Mission overhead vs worker looping) not determined.
